info.description: Management requires RS256 JWTs for the configured issuer/audience and aigw:manage scope. Business roles come from PostgreSQL. Amounts use the organization currency: MOCK integer test units or CNY_MICRO (one yuan = 1,000,000 units). Provider prices are operator-configured, not a supplier invoice. List cursors are keysets, not snapshots.

Consistent ledger metadata grouped by UTC admission date/project/model/provider/currency. from inclusive, to exclusive, 1..90 days. Maximum 1000 groups; overflow rejected, never truncated. Null attribution means no recorded attempt. Amounts and known-usage token totals are decimal strings. Organization scope requires owner/admin; project scope requires project access. Late settlements change historical reports. Export commits an audit event before CSV delivery; it is not an official supplier invoice.

get.description: Two-party organization ownership handoff. Existing member recipient must accept while both local identities (local mode) and role snapshot remain valid. Pending expires in 24 hours. Owner retains role until atomic acceptance, then becomes admin. Metadata visible only to requester/recipient; other members see null. No invitation, user creation, credential revocation or implicit content-auditor grant.

post.description: Authenticated intended recipient accepts; current requester/owner cancels. First committed decision wins, repeated or expired acceptance conflicts. Membership changes and audit are atomic. Former owner becomes admin, project credentials and content-auditor grants are not changed.

put.description: Organization-scoped lifecycle. Owner-only mutation; owner/self cannot be disabled. Atomic key revocation, project grant removal, content-auditor revocation, pending handoff cancellation and audit. Enabling requires an explicit role and never restores revoked keys or removed grants. Already-authorized in-flight inference may complete; other organizations/global login remain independent.

get.description: Organization owner/admin only. Atomic versioned department tree, scoped membership and project bindings. Ancestor grants inherit downwards; explicit project grants combine by strongest role under existing organization ceilings. Department changes do not revoke existing project keys. ExecutionAttempt.description: One durable attempt per reserved request; no retries. Completed means valid upstream result and durable local accounting/metadata, not client receipt. Unfinished can include crashed processes. Timing is wall-clock gateway execution time including accounting and metadata writes. Null on old or unrecorded requests.
